ABOUT

Stories first, formats second.

I am a video producer who thinks in stories first and formats second. I start with the idea and the audience, build the research and script around them, then carry it through shooting, on-camera presentation and the final edit, so the message stays sharp from the first frame to the last. My work so far spans technology, cars and big ideas, across shows, reviews, explainers and reels. Whatever the brief or the platform, my aim stays the same: make it clear, make it memorable, and make every second earn its place.
